final: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), f AS (SELECT g.ID, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS frac FROM g, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(frac) AS avg_frac FROM f) SELECT f.ID, f.cnt AS num_examinations, f.frac AS fraction, f.frac - a.avg_frac AS excess FROM f, a WHERE f.frac > a.avg_frac ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
